# NYS Department of Taxation and Finance Monthly Data Files




## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

rm(list = ls())
GITROOT <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file(".git/index"))
source(fs::path(GITROOT, "setup.R"))

```


```{r}

# D:/R_projects/nys_monthly_tax/data/monthly_collections.rds
fpath <- r"(D:/R_projects/nys_monthly_tax/data/monthly_collections.rds)"
dtfm <- readRDS(fpath)
skimr::skim(dtfm)
dtfm |>
  filter(date == as.Date("2020-09-01"))

dtfm |>
  filter(vname == "pit_wh", year(date) == 2020)


# winnow down to data we need
count(dtfm, typesort, type)
count(dtfm |> filter(typesort %in% 1:2), typesort, type, tax, vname)

pitsut <- dtfm |>
  filter(str_starts(vname, "pit_") | vname == "user_sut") |>
  select(vname, tax, date, sfy, value)

saveRDS(pitsut, fs::path(DDATA, "pitsut.rds"))

```

```{r}
#| label: explore

pitsut <- readRDS(fs::path(DDATA, "pitsut.rds"))

pitsut |>
  filter(vname == "pit_wh") |>
  summarise(pit_wh = sum(value), .by = sfy)

pitsut |>
  filter(vname == "pit_wh") |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()

# Convert to tsibble (time series tibble) with monthly interval
pdata <- pitsut |>
  filter(vname == "pit_wh") |>
  mutate(month = yearmonth(date)) |>
  as_tsibble(index = month)
# skimr::skim(pdata)
scan_gaps(pdata) # if there are gaps, fix them

pdata |>
  filter(year(date) >= 2024) |>
  ggtime::gg_season(value, period = "year") +
  labs(
    title = "Seasonal Pattern",
    x = "Month"
  )

# Ensure explicit gaps
pdata_f <- pdata |> tsibble::fill_gaps(value = NA)

# Option 1 — feasts/ggtime subseries (one panel per month)
pdata_f |>
  filter(year(date) >= 2022) |>
  ggtime::gg_subseries(value, period = "year") +
  labs(title = "Subseries plot (one panel per month)")

# Option 2 — single panel: a line per month across years
pdata_f |>
  mutate(
    year = year(month),
    m = factor(month(month, label = TRUE), levels = month.abb)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = value, group = m, color = m)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Lines by month across years", x = "Year", color = "Month")


pdata_f |>
  filter(year(date) >= 2023) |>
  ggtime::gg_subseries(value, period = "year") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::dollar_format(scale = 1e-9, suffix = "", accuracy = 0.1),
    breaks = seq(0, 10e9, by = 500e6)
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "C") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(title = "Withholding tax collections by month", y = "$ billions")

pdata_f |>
  arrange(date) |>
  tsibble::fill_gaps(value = NA) |>
  mutate(
    yoy = value / dplyr::lag(value, 12) - 1,
    year = year(date),
    mon = factor(month(date, label = TRUE), levels = month.abb)
  ) -> pdata_yoy

p_yoy <- pdata_yoy |>
  filter(year(date) >= 2023) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = yoy)) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "red") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "Year-over-year % change", y = "YoY %", x = "Date") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p_yoy

```
